dogecoin.text: @pmitch1978 @dogecoin_rise I understand but these incessant tweets every day of "this is it!" Or "something big is going to happen this week!" are ridiculously stupid. No, +.001 or even +.005 is not "something big"

@dogecoin_rise The average person doesn't have $100k of doge. Moving up .001 cent a day doesn't exactly move the needle much. Hard sell that it ever gets above even .10 which then what, you have $2k of Doge and now you've got $4k? Wow, life changing.
